name: SABnzbd
description: Download from Usenet, from a web page.
notes: The first visit runs a wizard for your Usenet provider; set the folders to /data/downloads/incomplete and /data/downloads/complete. If it says the hostname failed verification, open it once by the server's IP address and add the name under Config → Special → host_whitelist. Give every download app the same Media and downloads folder, with downloads in /data/downloads and your library in /data/media, so finished files move into the library without being copied. The folder must belong to the apps' user (or set APPS_MEDIA_UID and APPS_MEDIA_GID to its owner); point Jellyfin at the library inside it.
